chapter: Chicago, the Woodside, the army and 52nd Street
title: Arcadia Ballroom band: Eli Robinson, Prince Robinson, Panama Francis
summary: Collins names the strong players in the Arcadia band, unsure whether it was Roy's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: The arcade, it was at 53rd and Broadway, yeah. And why I mention this is because Les Brown had the band, and then in this band we had Eli Robinson, a very fine trombone player --
Talking about This wasn't Roy's Band?

Roy's Band, no. And what was Prince's name? Prince Robinson, also, fine saxophone player. Panama France's, and I'm just naming some of the guys, to show you the calibre of band. We had a very good band.
Can you remember the whole band?
